'''Gamma Squad''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit that [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="Episode V" />

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Gamma Squad was sent to Cloud City to help [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during his attempted capture of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Some of their members, along with Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[E-3PO (Bespin)/Legends|E-3PO]] were tasked with helping the city's [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] engineers convert the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon freezing]] chamber's chemical intermix ratio for [[Human/Legends|Human]] hibernation. While working, the troopers took to calling E-3PO "E-Gregious" because of his outlandish attitude, causing him to storm out. Some of the troopers were sitting down when [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], thinking he had heard his friend [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] enter the room they were in. In order to not blow their cover, C-3PO was shot by [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Drazin]]<ref name="Star Wars 43">[[Star Wars (1977) 43|''Star Wars'' (1977) 43]]</ref> and his body dumped in Cloud City's incinerator room.<ref name="Episode V" />
